title: Miso Butter Roast Squash Orzo
tagline: Autumn in a bowl, with a sneaky umami punch.

ingredients.item: butternut squash, peeled and cut into 2cm cubes
parmesan, finely grated, plus extra to serve
sage leaves, crisped in a little oil
lemon, zest and a squeeze of juice

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Mash the miso into the butter, toss half with the squash and roast for 30 minutes until golden and soft.
Meanwhile, melt the rest of the miso butter in a wide pan and soften the garlic for a minute.
Add the orzo, stir to coat, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 10 to 12 minutes until tender and creamy.
Fold in half the roast squash, mashing a little into the orzo, then stir through the parmesan and lemon.
Top with the remaining squash, crispy sage and more parmesan. Serve straight away.
image_prompt: A shallow bowl of creamy orzo studded with caramelised roast butternut squash cubes, topped with crispy sage leaves, shaved parmesan and lemon zest, a spoon resting in the bowl.
alt_text: A bowl of creamy orzo with golden roast squash cubes, crispy sage and shaved parmesan.
caption_hook:
Butter, miso and squash walked into a pan. Nobody walked out hungry.
Would you swap the orzo for risotto rice?
